claims.statement: For a rank-three spectral frame row v with c=|v|^2 and a=v^T Lambda v nonzero, the rank-two completed-square residual T has signed pseudodeterminant pdet(T)=c det(Lambda)/a.

claims.scope: Rank-exactly-three form; residual rank-two Schur form definite; arbitrary independent coordinate densities bounded by one.
Rank exactly three, all three nonzero eigenvalues same sign and magnitude at least one; arbitrary rotation and arbitrary independent coordinate densities bounded by one.

claims.statement: For a physical spectral-frame row v, sum_{j!=i} A_ij^2 = |Lambda v|^2-a^2 >= c-a^2 when all three singular eigenvalues have magnitude at least one.
Close the rank-three localized indefinite majority-pivot/near-isotropic branch by aggregating the forced cross energy without selecting one dimension-losing coordinate coefficient.
